title: 实验室安全基础：安全资源情景

author_source: project/CDC Laboratory Safety Series/03_Fundamentals of Laboratory Safety Safety Resources Scenario/src.py

points.K2: 担心暴露：这样做允许吗
points.K3: 有哪些安全资源可以求助

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣站在一片白色开放式办公区里，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in a bright white open-plan office area and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课是个情景题：安全问题找谁问？
overlay: 实验室安全基础：安全资源情景

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣举起一个大问号牌
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a big question mark sign and tilts its head.
shots.narration: 看完故事，请你一起来想答案。

shots.section_title: 办公区里的实验服
shots.scene: 办公区全景：办公桌、电脑、文件柜、会议桌椅
shots.prompt_en: A wide view of a white open office area with desks, blank computer screens, filing cabinets and a meeting table with chairs. No people.
shots.narration: 想象一下：你正穿过办公区。

shots.section_title: 办公区里的实验服
shots.scene: 小研抱着电脑走过办公桌之间的过道
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student carries a laptop and walks along the aisle between the office desks.
shots.narration: 这里没有实验台，只有电脑和文件。

shots.section_title: 办公区里的实验服
shots.scene: 阿杰穿着白色实验服、戴着护目镜，站在办公区中间
shots.prompt_en: The young male student, wearing a white lab coat and safety goggles, stands in the middle of the office area facing the camera.
shots.narration: 你看见一位同事，穿着实验服站在这里。

shots.section_title: 办公区里的实验服
shots.scene: 小研停下脚步，看着阿杰的实验服和护目镜
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops walking and looks at the young male student's lab coat and goggles.
shots.narration: 护目镜也还戴在脸上。

shots.section_title: 担心暴露：这样做允许吗
shots.scene: 小研皱眉思考，头顶浮现问号
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student frowns thoughtfully, a question mark icon floating above her head.
shots.narration: 你担心：这会不会带来暴露的风险？
overlay: 担心暴露：这样做允许吗

shots.section_title: 担心暴露：这样做允许吗
shots.scene: 实验服图标旁浮现一个小警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A lab coat icon with a small yellow warning triangle beside it, set against an office desk icon. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室里沾上的东西，会不会带出来？

shots.section_title: 担心暴露：这样做允许吗
shots.scene: 小研看看实验室的门，又看看办公区
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student looks back at the laboratory door and then at the office area.
shots.narration: 你也拿不准：非实验区，允许这样穿吗？

shots.section_title: 担心暴露：这样做允许吗
shots.scene: 阿杰若无其事地站着，翻看手里的文件
shots.prompt_en: The young male student, still in his lab coat and goggles, casually flips through some blank papers in the office area.
shots.narration: 同事却像平常一样，毫不在意。

shots.section_title: 担心暴露：这样做允许吗
shots.scene: 实验服图标和办公桌图标之间一个问号
shots.prompt_en: A lab coat icon and an office desk icon with a large question mark between them. No people.
shots.narration: 这算不算被认可的做法？

shots.section_title: 有哪些安全资源可以求助
shots.scene: 小研站在原地，手指托着下巴
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stands still with a finger on her chin, thinking hard.
shots.narration: 问题来了：有哪些安全资源，
overlay: 有哪些安全资源可以求助

shots.section_title: 有哪些安全资源可以求助
shots.scene: 护目镜、手套、实验服图标，旁边一个对话气泡和问号
shots.prompt_en: Icons of goggles, gloves and a lab coat, next to a speech bubble with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 能帮你讨论个人防护装备的问题？

shots.section_title: 有哪些安全资源可以求助
shots.scene: 多个对话气泡浮在办公区上空，里面都是问号
shots.prompt_en: Several speech bubbles with question marks floating over the office area. No people.
shots.narration: 还有其他和安全有关的担忧呢？

shots.section_title: 有哪些安全资源可以求助
shots.scene: 欣欣对着镜头，竖起一根手指放在嘴边
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot faces the camera and puts one finger to its lips, as if asking for quiet thinking.
shots.narration: 先别急着往下看，停下来想一想。

shots.section_title: 有哪些安全资源可以求助
shots.scene: 画面渐暗，只留一个沙漏图标
shots.prompt_en: The screen slowly dims, leaving only an hourglass icon with falling sand in the center. No people.
shots.narration: 给自己一点时间，好好想想。

shots.section_title: 有哪些安全资源可以求助
shots.scene: 小研在空白本子上列清单，若有所思
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student writes a list in a blank notebook, thinking.
shots.narration: 你身边，能找到哪些安全资源？

shots.section_title: 本课不能代替本实验室规程
shots.scene: 一张空白课程卡片和一本更大的空白规程手册
shots.prompt_en: A small blank course card next to a larger blank procedure binder with a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 本课面向实验室人员，
overlay: 本课不能代替本实验室规程

shots.section_title: 本课不能代替本实验室规程
shots.scene: 规程手册放大，旁边一个对勾
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the blank procedure binder with a large green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 不能代替你实验室自己的规程。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现办公桌和实验服图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of an office desk and a lab coat.
shots.narration: 办公区里，有人穿着实验服。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 警示三角和问号图标
shots.prompt_en: A yellow warning triangle icon next to a question mark icon. No people.
shots.narration: 担心暴露，也拿不准是否允许。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 一个大问号和对话气泡图标
shots.prompt_en: A large question mark inside a speech bubble, glowing. No people.
shots.narration: 能找哪些资源，讨论防护和安全？

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 欣欣对镜头眨眨眼
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot winks at the camera with a friendly smile.
shots.narration: 这道题，留给你自己找答案。

shots.section_title: 结尾
shots.scene: 欣欣和小研在办公区门口挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot and the female graduate student wave goodbye at the doorway of the office area.
shots.narration: 有疑问就去问，下次见！
